summary: Initializes a pit crew animation structure to defaults and releases any previously allocated resources: a 3D sound source, a raw buffer, and an array of 28-byte animation elements. Serves as an init/reinit cleanup hybrid invoked from the loader and UI/resource cleanup paths.

operations.description: Initialize the word state field at this+0x0 to 0 and the byte flags at this+0x2 (1 = enabled), this+0x3 (0), this+0x4 (0).
Initialize the dword region this+0x44..0x60: position/vector component to -1.0f (literal -1082130432), handle/index field to -1, and the remaining four dwords to 0.
If global dword_8AFE88 is set and this+0x64 holds a live 3D sound source, destroy it via F_3DSoundSourceDestructor.
Clear the sound-source pointer this+0x64 and the adjacent this+0x68 after sound cleanup.
If this+0x6C holds an allocated buffer, release it via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Clear the buffer pointer this+0x6C and the adjacent this+0x70 after buffer cleanup.
Save the array pointer at this+0x74; if nonzero, destruct its elements and free the allocation.
Element count is stored in the dword at the allocation base minus 4; iterate count elements of 28 bytes each in reverse, calling ShortComputation_d4d0 on every element.
Free the array allocation (header at base minus 4) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Clear this+0x74 to 0 after the array is freed.
Return the previously saved this+0x74 value (the freed array allocation address).

clean_pseudocode: if (array) { for (each of count elements) ShortComputation_d4d0(elem); FreeWrapper_7bcf(array_header); }
